timeline: absolute seconds in the fixed 242 s main cut; 242-252 is the alt tail (shot 46)
engine: ElevenLabs Eleven v4 TTS on fal; voices and settings from casting.md
rules: Each take is one request. Split it at its long pauses into line clips, trim each clip to 40 ms before its voiced onset, and place the voiced onset at start. dur is the voiced length window in seconds; end_by is the latest voiced end. Tags are behaviour only. Words are the script's (see changes).

NANA.voice: library voice ID chosen at audition (casting.md)

CITY.alternate: any unused General American stock voice

takes.speaker: FATHER
takes.text: Good evening, my children. [long pause] The harvest is in. [pause] The sea is calm. [long pause] I am well. [long pause] Eat something warm before you sleep.
takes.note: The opening broadcast (a replay of Night 211). Also the Engine's stock recordings: D17, D21, D27 and D28 reuse these clips, and the loop is spliced from them.

takes.speaker: FATHER
takes.text: Sleep safely; I am watching over you.
takes.note: The Engine's default sign-off, the cold line on every SIGN-OFFS row. Heard only inside the loop. Same seed as T01; previous_text: I am well.

takes.speaker: FATHER
takes.text: I died in the spring. [long pause] I'm sorry I stayed so long. [long pause] Tomorrow, [short pause] you'll have to talk to each other.
takes.note: The only new words in the Address. previous_text: Good evening, my children. next_text: Eat something warm before you sleep. Same seed as T01: the same calm as every night, no more feeling than the lies had.

takes.speaker: IDA
takes.text: [under her breath] Hold still. [long pause] [exhales slowly]
takes.note: Scene 1. Murmured to a face she is touching: voiced, not whispered.

takes.speaker: IDA
takes.note: Scene 2. Flat, low, no stress on not. If it reads as a retort, reseed; do not add tags.

takes.speaker: IDA
takes.text: [quietly] /ˈnænə/. [short pause] Don't wait up tonight. [long pause] [quietly] Why do you still watch him?
takes.note: Scene 3, the first call. next_text for context: I always wait up. He's on soon.

takes.speaker: IDA
takes.text: [quietly] /ˈnænə/, I— [long pause] [quietly] How long? [long pause] [breathes in] [long pause] [exhales] [laughs quietly] [exhales slowly]
takes.note: Scene 6, the second call and the thermos. The laugh is one small laugh through the nose; reseed until it is, never tag it bigger.

takes.speaker: NANA
takes.text: I always wait up. [short pause] He's on soon. [long pause] For the ending. [pause] Eat something warm, love.
takes.note: Scene 3. previous_text: Nana. Don't wait up tonight.

takes.speaker: NANA
takes.text: [softly] I know, love. [long pause] [exhales through her nose] Since he started telling me to eat. [long pause] Come home. [short pause] The soup's still warm.
takes.note: Scene 6, one take for all of Nana's call-back lines (the v2 lesson, now by construction). previous_text: Nana, I.

takes.speaker: PA
takes.text: Four minutes. [long pause] One minute. [long pause] Ten seconds.
takes.note: One session in Year One. The three contours must match; reseed the whole take, never one phrase.

takes.speaker: CITY

changes: D17, D21, D27 and D28 reuse the D01, D04, D01 and D03 clips sample for sample: the Engine replays its template and its learned sign-off, and only the lines Ida typed (D18-D20) are new recordings.
D06 is spliced from the cold open's own audio plus one new fragment (T02), not read; its words and order are the script's, the later ones overlapping. D07 is copies of D03.
D20 starts at 167.4 (v2 168.6), so Tomorrow is heard in shot 31 and the cut to 32 falls in its comma pause. The conform must end shot 31's take segment just after Tomorrow.

Voiced onsets move from the v2 Seedance takes back to the shot specs (audio now leads picture): D01 5.0 to 5.6, D04 16.0 to 15.6, D08 73.0 to 72.2, D10 90.0 to 90.5, D11 94.0 to 94.5, D12 100.5 to 100.1, D22 195.0 to 195.7, D23 199.5 to 198.7, D24 203.2 to 202.9, D25 205.9 to 205.7, D26 211.5 to 211.4.
Nana is pronounced /ˈnænə/ everywhere (IPA in D10 and D22).
New non-verbal lines by the cast voices: V01 (07), V02-V04 (42, the laugh), V05 (41).
The walla is rewritten for real voices: nine people, ten lines, two intelligible (What happens now? / I don't know.); adds Have you eaten?; drops the macOS voice list.
